name: threat-intel-marketplace
description: A single-plugin marketplace hosting the Threat Intel Toolkit — defensive IOC triage on free, key-free open-source threat feeds.

plugins.name: threat-intel-toolkit
plugins.description: Defensive IOC + vulnerability triage: a subagent plus two skills — threat-intel-lookup (aggregates 10 key-free feeds; looks up IPs, domains, URLs, CVEs) and exploit-availability-check (rates a CVE's exploit/PoC maturity). No API keys required.
